subject: Tolub
fact: Tolub betrayed the party by sending them into a trap at the fire temple instead of connecting them with Romag of the Earth Temple as promised.
source_quote: They had been betrayed by Captain Tolub, who sent them into a trap at the fire temple instead of connecting them with Romag of the Earth Temple as promised.

subject: Albreth
fact: Albreth, a fire priest, unleashed devastating magical flames upon the party, nearly killing Calmer.
source_quote: Fire priests Albreth and Ingulf had unleashed devastating magical flames upon them, nearly killing Calmer.

subject: Ingulf
fact: Ingulf, a fire priest, unleashed devastating magical flames upon the party, nearly killing Calmer.
source_quote: Fire priests Albreth and Ingulf had unleashed devastating magical flames upon them, nearly killing Calmer.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer recovered from his brush with death and insisted the party change their approach, declaring he was done being the face of the party.
source_quote: Calmer, recovered from his brush with death, insisted they needed to change their approach. He declared he was done being the face of the party, tired of looking like a fool and nearly getting killed.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr used magical dust to allow the party to vanish and flee into the darkness.
source_quote: Zephyr’s quick thinking with magical dust allowed them to vanish and flee into the darkness.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia’s concern for Calmer’s wellbeing brought a moment of levity, though Calmer claimed it was merely because reviving him was annoying.
source_quote: Zinnia’s concern for Calmer’s wellbeing—though he claimed it was merely because reviving him was annoying—brought a moment of levity to their tense situation.

subject: Nulb
fact: Nulb is the destination where the party plans to confront Tolub and demand an audience with the temple leadership.
source_quote: They agreed on a plan: return to Nulb and confront Tolub, proving they had survived whatever test he had thrown at them, and demand an audience with the temple leadership.

subject: Boatman’s Tavern
fact: The Boatman’s Tavern in Nulb is where Skole, the bartender, revealed Tolub had been lying about the party’s death.
source_quote: Upon reaching Nulb, the party made their way to the Boatman’s Tavern. Skole, the bartender, was visibly shocked to see them alive.

subject: Skole
fact: Skole, the bartender of the Boatman’s Tavern, despised both Tolub and Lodriss, the tavern’s actual owner, and wished to be free of them both.
source_quote: Taking them into his back room, Skole confided that he despised both Tolub and Lodriss, the tavern’s actual owner, and wished to be free of them both.

subject: Lodriss
fact: Lodriss is the actual owner of the Boatman’s Tavern, despised by Skole.
source_quote: Taking them into his back room, Skole confided that he despised both Tolub and Lodriss, the tavern’s actual owner, and wished to be free of them both.

subject: Dick Rentsch
fact: Dick Rentsch, proprietor of the Waterside Hostel, told the party they needed to speak with him to contact the Earth Temple, not Tolub.
source_quote: He told them that if they wanted to contact the Earth Temple, they needed to speak with Dick Rentsch at the Waterside Hostel, not Tolub, who worked for the fire prophet.

subject: Waterside Hostel
fact: The Waterside Hostel is a dilapidated building with sagging timbers and lopsided walls where Dick Rentsch runs a tight operation.
source_quote: At the Waterside Hostel, a dilapidated building with sagging timbers and lopsided walls, they met Dick Rentsch.

subject: Gallows Table
fact: Gallows Table is where Elfar Twell was executed on the orders of Madame Selentis and hung from the gallows.
source_quote: They passed Gallows Table where they saw a dead man hanging from the gallows—Elfar Twell, executed on the orders of the powerful Madame Selentis for the crime of crossing her.

subject: Madame Selentis
fact: Madame Selentis ordered the execution of Elfar Twell for crossing her.
source_quote: They passed Gallows Table where they saw a dead man hanging from the gallows—Elfar Twell, executed on the orders of the powerful Madame Selentis for the crime of crossing her.

subject: Magda’s Trove
fact: Magda’s Trove is a merchant stall selling strange magical curiosities like cursed ink.
source_quote: They encountered various merchant stalls, including Magda’s Trove with its strange magical curiosities like cursed ink,

subject: Garik’s Armory
fact: Garik’s Armory is a merchant stall selling rusted weapons.
source_quote: They encountered various merchant stalls, including Magda’s Trove with its strange magical curiosities like cursed ink, and Garik’s armory selling rusted weapons.

subject: Wat
fact: Wat, the bartender at the Waterside Hostel, attempted to extract information about the party’s business and warned them not to drink the beer, serving gin instead.
source_quote: While waiting for Dick Rentsch to return that evening, the party was approached by Wat, the bartender, who attempted to extract information about their business. The party deflected his questions, claiming it was a personal matter. Wat seemed relieved and mentioned someone named Dala before warning them not to drink the beer and serving them gin instead.

subject: Dala
fact: Dala is someone mentioned by Wat as a reference point during his warning to the party.
source_quote: Wat seemed relieved and mentioned someone named Dala before warning them not to drink the beer and serving them gin instead.

subject: Sequioa
fact: Sequioa noticed the gnolls seemed to be on patrol, possibly looking for the party or dealing with bandit factions.
source_quote: Sequioa noticed the gnolls seemed to be on patrol, possibly looking for the party themselves or dealing with the various bandit factions that plagued the region.

subject: Bandit Chief
fact: The bandit chief led a group of gnolls through the forest and was later killed by Sequioa and Zinnia during the ambush.
source_quote: The party struck swiftly and decisively. Sequioa and Zinnia focused their attacks on the bandit chief, cutting him down before he could react.

subject: Forest
fact: The forest is where the party encountered gnolls in fire temple garb, a collapsed patch of ground revealing poisonous snakes, and later ambushed the bandit chief and his recruits.
source_quote: As they drew closer to Nulb, the party observed a bandit chief leading another group of gnolls through the forest... The party returned to the forest and positioned themselves for the ambush.

subject: Gnoll King
fact: The gnoll king is the source from whom the fire temple recruits gnolls, according to the bandit chief’s mutterings.
source_quote: Sequioa’s keen hearing picked up the chief muttering complaints about recruiting gnolls from the local gnoll king for the fire temple.

subject: Temple of Elemental Evil
fact: The Temple of Elemental Evil is actively growing and recruiting forces, with four cults led by prophets: Romag of Earth, Belsornig of Water, and two unnamed leaders of Fire and Air, all ruled by a mysterious deep temple.
source_quote: The Temple of Elemental Evil wasn’t just surviving, it was actively growing and recruiting forces... four cults led by prophets—Romag of Earth, Belsornig of Water, and two unnamed leaders of Fire and Air—all ruled by a mysterious deep temple.

subject: Belsornig
fact: Belsornig is the prophet of Water within the Temple of Elemental Evil.
source_quote: four cults led by prophets—Romag of Earth, Belsornig of Water, and two unnamed leaders of Fire and Air—all ruled by a mysterious deep temple.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag is the prophet of Earth within the Temple of Elemental Evil, whom Tolub was supposed to connect the party with.
source_quote: They had been betrayed by Captain Tolub, who sent them into a trap at the fire temple instead of connecting them with Romag of the Earth Temple as promised.

subject: Elfar Twell
fact: Elfar Twell was executed and hanged at Gallows Table for crossing Madame Selentis.
source_quote: They passed Gallows Table where they saw a dead man hanging from the gallows—Elfar Twell, executed on the orders of the powerful Madame Selentis for the crime of crossing her.

subject: Cave
fact: The party rested in a well-hidden cave found by Zinnia, who carefully obscured their tracks.
source_quote: Zinnia’s expertise proved invaluable as he found them a well-hidden cave to rest in and carefully obscured their tracks.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia moved with deadly precision during the ambush, contributing to the efficient elimination of the gnolls.
source_quote: Sequioa delivered a devastating strike that literally cut one gnoll in half, while Zinnia moved with deadly precision through the chaos.

subject: Sequioa
fact: Sequioa delivered a devastating strike that literally cut one gnoll in half during the ambush.
source_quote: Sequioa delivered a devastating strike that literally cut one gnoll in half, while Zinnia moved with deadly precision through the chaos.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr methodically eliminated the gnolls one by one during the ambush.
source_quote: Zephyr methodically eliminated them one by one.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer created a terrifying booming voice that froze the gnolls in fear during the ambush.
source_quote: Calmer created a terrifying booming voice that froze the gnolls in fear,

subject: Ambush on Gnoll Recruits
fact: The party ambushed and killed a group of gnolls and their handler, the bandit chief, proving their capability to the Earth Temple.
source_quote: The party returned to the forest and positioned themselves for the ambush... When the dust settled, the party stood victorious over the bodies of their enemies, having proven themselves capable of the ruthless work the Earth Temple required.

subject: Completion of Dick Rentsch’s Test
fact: The party successfully completed Dick Rentsch’s mission to kill the gnoll recruits and their handler, earning their entry into the Temple of Elemental Evil.
source_quote: They had successfully completed Dick Rentsch’s test and earned their entry into the Temple of Elemental Evil.

subject: Nulb
fact: Nulb is a desperate, dangerous place where power is everything, as shown by its merchant stalls, executions, and hidden factions.
source_quote: These encounters painted a picture of Nulb as a desperate, dangerous place where power was everything.

subject: Waterside Hostel
fact: The Waterside Hostel is neutral ground where various factions, including the bandit chief, coexist uneasily.
source_quote: they noticed the bandit chief from the forest was also present in the tavern, suggesting this was neutral ground where various factions coexisted uneasily.
